name: Extra Whisper
body:
You have discovered a new aspect of your calling.

Prerequisite: Whisper class feature.

Benefit: You gain one additional whisper. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this whisper.

Special: You can gain Extra Whisper multiple times.

Mysteries of the Dead Side: The Sacred Necromancer, © 2012 Zombie Sky Press; Author: Scott Gable, Will McCardell, Matthew Pauze.
